dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port-count mixes, rated-power trajectories and CAD2022 equipment/installation costs per port. Convert total port expenditure divided by total rated power to model costs. Common 0.20 utilization is a user-reviewed consistency override for vintage-indexed limits, not a direct source observation; final cost/power values beyond 2040 retain the reviewed endpoint.
legacy_charging_profiles: Frozen Ontario RAMP-mobility charging simulations using 2018 weather and embedded fleet, range and charger composition; normalized load shapes, not measured charger utilization.
  - nhts: Ontario charging simulation with NHTS 2022 travel inputs and 2018 weather; inherited BEV fleet and charger mix also proxy other regions and shared LDV charging.

Common 0.20 utilization is a user-reviewed consistency override for vintage-indexed limits, not a direct source observation; final cost/power values beyond 2040 retain the reviewed endpoint.
legacy_charging_profiles: Frozen Ontario RAMP-mobility charging simulations using 2018 weather and embedded fleet, range and charger composition; normalized load shapes, not measured charger utilization.
  - nhts: Ontario charging simulation with NHTS 2022 travel inputs and 2018 weather; inherited BEV fleet and charger mix also proxy other regions and shared LDV charging.
